de: Trinken Sie viel Wasser bei der Hitze.
Die Stadt ist am Vormittag am belebtesten.
Fragen Sie die Einheimischen nach dem Weg.
ro: Beți multă apă din cauza căldurii.
Orașul este cel mai animat în timpul dimineții.
en: Drink plenty of water throughout the heat of the day.
The town is most active during the morning hours.
Don't hesitate to ask locals for directions.
